name: Wand Rogue (Ex)
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Advanced Rogue Talents, Magic Adept.

Benefit: Activating a wand is a move action for a rogue with this talent.

Normal: Activating a wand is a standard action.
